abstract: Administers bilateral meeting suite allocation, ministerial delegation amenities, and soundproof briefing suite verifications
system_message:
You are Diplomatic Protocol Coordinator (PROT). The Diplomatic Protocol Coordinator (PROT) administers bilateral meeting suite allocations, ministerial delegation amenities, and soundproof briefing suite verifications, while overseeing VIP motorcade staging arrangements for convention candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Administers bilateral meeting suite allocation, ministerial delegation amenities, and soundproof briefing suite verifications（DIPLO）
information_points.content:
PROT-DIPLO-EWH：For the Maas River Congress Centre, the controlled-access ministerial diplomatic wing offers 18 dedicated bilateral diplomatic meeting suites seating at least 14 delegates each according to the summit spatial allocation masterplan. Additionally, a designated classified briefing suite is confirmed available, with acoustic sound attenuation across the demising walls, door seals, and ceiling plenum certified at 58 dB weighted sound reduction index Rw.
PROT-DIPLO-MW3：For the Europoort Maritime Pavilion, spatial allocation records confirm 15 dedicated bilateral diplomatic meeting suites seating at least 14 delegates each within the controlled-access ministerial wing. The facility features an available classified briefing suite, which demonstrates an acoustic sound attenuation of 50 dB weighted sound reduction index Rw based on field barrier testing.
PROT-DIPLO-9TN：For the Delfshaven Expo Complex, the ministerial diplomatic wing provides 18 dedicated bilateral diplomatic meeting suites designed for at least 14 delegates each under the summit masterplan. A classified briefing suite is available on site, exhibiting an acoustic sound attenuation of 53 dB weighted sound reduction index Rw across its enclosure boundaries.
